insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Reshoevn8r Canada grew total sales to $2,407 for Week 46, up +2.7% WoW from $2,343, on 84 units. The Signature Kit led the account at $843 (+64.4%) on 15 units, the 8oz Cleaning Solution climbed to $262 (+54.7%), and the Nubuck & Suede Kit reached $130 (+148.3%). Tuesday, Nov 10 was the peak day at $569.

**Metrics to Watch —** Organic sales eased to $923 (-8.5% WoW) as more of this week's volume came through ads, with PPC revenue up to $1,483 (+11.2%). Conversion held up well: the Signature Kit CVR rose to 7.5% (+42.5%) and the Refresh Kit reached 11.0% (+37.8%) at $345 (+15.6%), while the Waterproof Shoe Spray came in at $255 (-6.1%) on sessions of 84 (-7.7%). We are focused on rebuilding traffic to the Refresh Kit (127 sessions, -15.3%) and Waterproof Shoe Spray to lift organic volume.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** Efficiency improved sharply: ad spend came in at $587 versus $752 the prior week while PPC revenue grew to $1,483 (+11.2%), lifting ROAS to 2.53x from 1.77x. TACoS improved to 24.4% from 32.10%, with ACOS at 39.6%, a 9.84% ad CVR and a 0.29% ad CTR.

**Actions This Week —** We will keep the tighter bid structure behind the 2.53x ROAS and shift incremental budget toward the Signature Kit and Refresh Kit, where CVR is rising (7.5% and 11.0%). We will add targeted campaigns to rebuild sessions for the Refresh Kit and Waterproof Shoe Spray to bring organic sales back above $923, and test new ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.29% heading into the holiday season.
